out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment Components, Adjusted per Manufacturer
violations.observation: The door gaskets of the following unit(s) are damaged: 1 Dr coffee unit.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment components such as doors, seals, hinges, fasteners, and kick plates shall be kept intact, tight, and adjusted in accordance with manufacturer's specifications.

violations.title: Nonfood-Contact Surfaces Kept Clean
violations.observation: The nonfood-contact surfaces of the following equipment had accumulations of grime and debris: Ice cream machine observed with debris from McFlurry toppings. Ice cream cone dispenser observed with accumulation of crumbs and debris.
violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. Manager removed cone holders to wash and sanitize

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the BACK PREP LINE being used to dump sauces.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. EHS instructed for items to be dumped in the prep sink.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Sanitizers, Criteria
violations.observation: The concentration of the QUATERNARY AMMONIUM SANITIZER solution was measured at ABOVE 400ppm. This concentration exceeds the approved limits for use with food-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils in a foodservice establishment.
violations.corrective_action: Maintain the concentration of Quaternary Ammonium solution at 150-400ppm. Verify concentration using the appropriate test kit. -EHS instructed employee to add water to sanitizer solution to dilute, tested at 200ppm. Please have Ecolab recalibrate chemical sanitizer dispenser. Dilute chemical with water until system is recalibrated.
